title: RNA Extraction and RT-qPCR Protocol
author: Peter H L Krijger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bxh9pj96
materials: Briefly spin the qPCR plate ( 500 x g, °C, 1 minute ) and transfer immediately to a Quantstudio 7 thermocycler.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Racks
steps.instruction: Assemble micronic tube racks containing the following: 1 positive extraction control (A1), 1 negative extraction control (B1), 1 negative amplification control (C1), and 93 swab specimens.

steps.title: Centrifuge and Load Samples
steps.instruction: Briefly spin the micronic tube racks in an under-bench centrifuge for 00:01:00 at 500 x g and place them in the Tecan Fluent carousel with barcodes facing the user.

steps.title: Initialize Automated Workflow
steps.instruction: Start the RNA extraction and qPCR setup script to initiate the automated workflow.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the beads/isopropanol mixture and transfer to the spinvessel.

substeps.instruction: Take 10ml aliquots of beads/isopropanol mixture from 4 °C storage.
Vortex and resuspend in 2-Propanol according to steps 11-14 of the bead preparation protocol by Peter Krijger.
Transfer diluted beads into the spinvessel and start the spinvessel to keep beads in solution (beads are stable for 5 days at RT).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Hardware
steps.instruction: Refill and prepare the necessary liquids and consumables for the robot.

substeps.instruction: Refill Nuclease-Free Water in the 80 °C H2O bath and turn on the bath.
Refill 70% EtOH in the hydrospeed tank.
Load RNA extraction plates, EtOH plates, 384-well qPCR plates, 125 µl disposable tips, and 50 µl disposable tips into the stacker.
Verify sufficient seal is present in the plate sealer.
Empty waste bins if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the RT-qPCR mix in a 50 ml tube wrapped in aluminum foil and place it in the cooling unit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 700 reactions of RT-qPCR mix per 384-well plate to account for dead volume in the tube and tubing.

steps.title: Sample Processing and RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the automated RNA extraction process across the extraction plates.

substeps.instruction: Scan collection tube 2D barcodes using a Ziath Mirage Barcode Scanner.
Place a 150 µl RNA extraction plate on the deck.
De-cap micronic tubes (96 samples) using the Brooks IntelliXCap 96 Capping/Decapping Unit.
Using 125 µl tips on the MCA96 head, aspirate 30 µl bead solution and 60 µl sample, dispense the 90 µl total into the extraction plate, and mix 5x.
Recap micronic tubes and return to the Tecan carousel.
Repeat the above process for 3 additional 96-tube racks to fill the RNA extraction plate.
Incubate for 00:02:00.
Place the RNA extraction plate on the magnetic deck and incubate for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Wash and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Wash the beads and elute the RNA using the automated system.

substeps.instruction: Place a 300 µl waste collection plate on the deck.
Fill a 150 µl EtOH plate with 150 µl 70% ethanol using the Hydrospeed and place on the deck.
Replace MCA 96 head with MCA 384 head and attach 384x 125 µl tips.
Aspirate supernatant from the RNA extraction plate and transfer to the waste plate.
Aspirate 30 µl 70% EtOH from the EtOH plate, dispense into the extraction plate, and mix 3 times.
Place the extraction plate on the magnetic deck and incubate for 00:00:30.
Aspirate EtOH from the extraction plate and transfer to the waste plate.
Place the extraction plate on the Bioshake and heat at 80 °C for 00:02:00.
Seal the waste plate and transfer to the waste bin.
Remove the lid from the 80 °C H2O bath; using 50 µl 384 pipet tips on the MCA 384 head, aspirate 25 µl H2O, dispense into the extraction plate, and mix 21x (total incubation 00:02:00) to elute RNA.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer eluted RNA and master mix to the qPCR plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 7.5 µl of multiplex RT-qPCR master mix to a barcoded 384-well qPCR plate.
Transfer 7.5 µl of extracted RNA (from the 25 µl total) from the extraction plate to the qPCR plate using the H2O pipetting tips.
Scan the barcode of the sealed qPCR plate and store it in the robot.
Transfer the EtOH plate to the waste bin.

steps.title: RT-qPCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Run the RT-qPCR program on a Quantstudio 7 thermocycler using the following parameters:

substeps.instruction: 1x 300s at 55 °C
1x 20s at 95 °C
40x 3s at 95 °C
30 cycles at 58 °C

steps.title: Data Processing and Curation
steps.instruction: Process the output using LabTrain software by Bodegro.

substeps.instruction: Manually curate positive samples.
Repeat negative samples showing inhibition of PDV amplification (Cq > 33).
Send results digitally to CoronIT.
